Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, respond.io is an AI-powered business messaging platform that helps companies manage customer conversations across chat, calls and email — all in one place.


Trusted by businesses in over 127 countries and recognized by G2 and SME100, respond.io enables fast-growing companies around the world to capture, convert, and retain customers at scale.


We operate as a globally distributed team with employees based around the world, contributing to a diverse and inclusive culture. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of customer conversation management!


Our Culture

At respond.io, we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here’s what we stand for:

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!
  • Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together.
  • Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We’re a team!


Role Description

At Respond.io, the role of Customer Success Manager is pivotal to our company's success. As a Customer Success Manager, you will be the go-to resource for top-tier customers to ensure successful product adoption and retention. This role entails handling clients onboarding, clients retention, and success planning.


Our ideal candidate will have the experience of working in a B2B SaaS company, and handling a fair share of different business processes. We are seeking someone who can ensure that our clients receive a great experience while working with us.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate closely with customers to understand their goals and help them maximize the value of the Respond.io platform
  • Assist customers during the onboarding process, ensuring a positive and smooth experience
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders
  • Act as a point of contact for customer issues and ensure timely resolution
  • Gain a deep understanding of customer needs, use cases, and objectives to ensure effective utilization of the Respond.io platform
  • Monitor and report on customer satisfaction and platform usage
  • Focus on maintaining high customer satisfaction and retention rates
  • Acquire in-depth knowledge of the Respond.io platform and identify opportunities for customer growth, collaborating with the internal team to propose upsells


Qualifications

  • 3+ years of B2B SaaS experience in Customer Success, Consulting, and Account Management
  • Experienced in working with international customers and handling global accounts
  • Attentive listener with an ability to address customer concerns effectively
  • Strong communication skills in Arabic and English to convey complex ideas clearly
  • Skilled in negotiating complex renewal contracts in a SaaS environment
  • Proficient in optimizing complex business processes
  • Familiarity with business messaging platforms, CRM systems, and Customer Success tools
  • Passionate about digital transformation and understanding diverse businesses
  • Ability to provide customer feedback and insights to various departments for product improvement
  • Deep understanding of our products, industry trends, and competition
  • Able to quickly grasp technical concepts and keen to become an expert in our software
  • An agile team player who is excited by the fast-paced start-up environment and is eager to make a difference


Here's what's in for you

  • You will become part of an amazing culture with smart, collaborative teammates who actually care about each other's growth and success.
  • You will grow more here than you would anywhere else, that is a promise.
  • Virtual events like talent shows, Among Us nights, and online game sessions to keep the fun going, no matter where you are!
  • We offer a highly competitive compensation package.
  • You'll receive a medical allowance to support your health and wellness needs.
  • Flexible working environment and working hours that fit your lifestyle, wherever you're based.

  • Perfil mão na massa , confortável em testar soluções rapidamente;

  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de colaboração com times multidisciplinares.

Location: LATAM

Team: Customer Support

Role: Technical Customer Support (LATAM)

Mode: Remote


About Respond.io

Founded in Hong Kong in early 2017, respond.io is an AI-powered business messaging platform that helps companies manage customer conversations across chat, calls and email — all in one place.


Trusted by businesses in over 127 countries and recognized by G2 and SME100, respond.io enables fast-growing companies around the world to capture, convert, and retain customers at scale.


We operate as a globally distributed team with employees based around the world, contributing to a diverse and inclusive culture. Join us, and be part of a team that is shaping the future of customer conversation management!


Our Culture

At respond.io, we move fast, work smart, and always keep our customers at the heart of what we do. Here’s what we stand for:

  • Solve Customer Problems: Every effort must solve real customer pain points. No guesswork—just real feedback and clear value!
  • The 80/20 Rule: We focus on 20% of actions that create 80% of the value. Simple is powerful—it gets us moving fast.
  • 100% Alignment, 80% Accuracy: We aim 100% team alignment and 80% accuracy. Perfect plans can wait—clear goals come first.
  • Be Direct: We give honest feedback, and tackle problems head-on. Clarity moves us forward!
  • Own It and Support Each Other: We step up, help out, and drive outcomes—together.
  • Build Human Connections: Work is better when we trust, care, and celebrate wins together. We’re a team!


Role Description

At Respond.io, Technical Customer Support are pivotal to our company’s success. You will be the go-to resource for our valued customers to obtain clarification when needed, provide best solution, and support any technical matters. In this role, your main priority is to drive excellent support and maintain customer satisfaction.


Responsibilities

  • Deliver high-quality support to customers of our SaaS product
  • Communicate and respond to varied technical business solutions to customers in a team environment, using our shared inbox tool to assist with customer inquiries
  • Resolve customer inquiries in a timely manner using full understanding of the product value, functions, features, and customer’s business needs
  • Monitor common customer questions/concerns and partner with cross-functional teams to suggest solutions
  • Empower customers to self-serve and help users navigate our on-demand success resources
  • Work collaboratively across teams — Customer, Marketing, Product, and Tech — to solve complex problems
  • Provide customer support via multiple channels including chat, and video calls


Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in a Customer Support role preferably in a SaaS or IT company
  • Experience in at least one of the following : API integrations, WhatsApp API, or Agentic AI
  • Excellent communication skills in Spanish and English, and the proven ability to understand customer’s inquiries
  • Ability to clearly explain complex ideas verbally and in writing
  • Ability to dig deeper to uncover customer’s true objectives
  • High level of empathy - it’s important for our Customer Support Associate to be a good person to peers and customers
  • Able to work in a fixed shift
  • Team-oriented mindset with a “thirst for more” attitude — always eager to learn, improve, and take on new challenges


Here's What's In For You

  • You will become part of an amazing culture with smart, collaborative teammates who actually care about each other's growth and success.
  • You will grow more here than you would anywhere else, that is a promise.
  • Virtual events like Talent Shows, Among Us nights, and online game sessions to keep the fun going, no matter where you are!
  • We offer a highly competitive compensation package.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Company: Fraud Deflect


Role: Data Analyst


Language: Native/fluent English. Resumes in English.


About the role

Help Fraud Deflect turn data into clear, reliable insights across fraud, chargebacks, alerts, and operational performance. The focus is working within the current stack to improve reporting, analysis, data quality, and decision-making, not rebuilding everything from scratch.


Responsibilities

  • Own reporting and analysis for core business datasets.
  • Build and maintain dashboards, recurring reports, and KPI tracking.
  • Write and optimize SQL for analysis, reporting, and data validation.
  • Analyze fraud, chargeback, dispute, and merchant trends to identify risks, patterns, and opportunities.
  • Investigate anomalies, data issues, and performance changes across key metrics.
  • Partner with engineering, product, operations, and leadership to answer business questions with data.
  • Work with existing pipelines and datasets to improve trust, consistency, and usability of data.
  • Use Python for analysis, validation, and lightweight automation where needed.
  • Support data quality efforts by identifying gaps, inconsistencies, and edge cases in source data.
  • Create clear visualizations and communicate findings in a practical, business-friendly way.
  • Work within the current stack (MySQL, AWS, Airflow; ClickHouse is a plus).


Required

  • Strong MySQL/SQL skills.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving.
  • Experience building dashboards and reports.
  • Ability to translate business questions into clear analysis.
  • Experience working with production data and validating data quality.
  • Python proficiency for analysis or automation.
  • Strong communication and troubleshooting skills.
  • Comfortable working with existing systems and improving them incrementally.


Nice to have

  • Experience with fraud, payments, chargebacks, disputes, or risk data.
  • Experience with Airflow or other scheduled workflow tools.
  • AWS experience.
  • Observability/visualization experience (metrics, dashboards, alerting).
  • Prior ClickHouse experience.
  • Basic Linux/CLI comfort.


How to apply

Send an English resume and links to APIs/code/docs showing Python, Clickhouse, SQL, automation, and payments/chargebacks work.

title: Senior Mainframe Automation Engineer
description:
Descrição da Vaga:

“Estamos buscando um Engenheiro Sênior de Automação de Mainframe experiente para liderar a migração e otimização de soluções de automação em mainframe. Esta função tem como foco a transição do CA OPS/MVS para o IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e do CA Automation Point para o IBM Systems Automation for Integrated Operations Management (SAIOM) .

O candidato ideal terá um papel crítico para garantir a eficiência operacional, a disponibilidade dos sistemas e processos de automação contínuos em um ambiente z/OS complexo.

Você irá colaborar de perto com a equipe de Automação para implementar soluções de automação baseadas em políticas, reduzir a sobrecarga administrativa e aumentar a capacidade de resposta dos sistemas. Esta posição não impacta o desenvolvimento de aplicações, mas influencia significativamente as estratégias e operações de automação.”


Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Liderar projetos de migração de CA OPS/MVS para IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS e de CA Automation Point para IBM SAIOM.
  • Configurar e implementar soluções IBM Systems Automation, incluindo automação baseada em políticas para ambientes z/OS.
  • Desenvolver e manter regras de automação, execs REXX e configurações do System Automation Policy Database (PDB) .
  • Prestar suporte na instalação e configuração de produtos de automação da IBM.
  • Colaborar com as equipes de operações para otimizar processos de inicialização, desligamento e recuperação dos sistemas.
  • Garantir alta disponibilidade e eficiência dos sistemas críticos por meio de estratégias proativas de automação.
  • Documentar processos, configurações e etapas de migração, garantindo comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Identificar e resolver problemas relacionados à automação em ambientes de produção.


Quais são as habilidades obrigatórias e níveis de proficiência exigidos para esta posição?

  • Experiência em Operações de Mainframe: Mínimo de 5+ anos em ambiente de operações de mainframe, em funções operacionais, de serviços, consultoria ou suporte.
  • IBM Tivoli Systems Automation for z/OS: Conhecimento avançado e experiência prática.
  • CA OPS/MVS: Avançado.
  • TSO e ISPF: Proficiência no uso dessas ferramentas para gerenciamento de sistemas.
  • JCL: Fortes habilidades em Job Control Language.
  • Programação REXX: Capacidade de escrever e manter scripts REXX.
  • System Automation Policy Database (PDB): Conhecimento prático obrigatório.
  • Experiência em Migração: Histórico comprovado em projetos de migração de automação em z/OS.
  • NetView for z/OS: Experiência na implementação e utilização deste produto.
  • Scripting REXX: Avançado.


Quais são as habilidades opcionais e níveis de proficiência desejáveis para esta posição?

  • Conhecimento de outros softwares IBM Z, incluindo operação, configuração e automação de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com processos de inicialização e desligamento do sistema z/OS.
  • Experiência com SMP/E para instalação e manutenção de software.
  • Entendimento de produtos de automação concorrentes no ecossistema de mainframe.
  • Especialização em configurações de sistemas totalmente automatizados em IBM Z.

title: English Teacher with Advanced Portuguese Skills
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Interested?

title: Senior Java Developer
description:

Where you Fit In



You'll be a key player within the Sportingtech Team and joining a group of highly skilled professionals, with a pivotal responsibility in creating performing and scalable Java-based solutions across our award-winning iGaming Platform.

As a Senior Java developer you'll become a part of our multinational Scrum teams to create state-of-the-art software solutions. In all teams we cooperate with internal and external experts from different knowledge domains to discover and build the best solutions possible.


Technologies Used:



Java 8+, Spring Boot, RabbitMQ, Kafka, JDBC, NoSQL, Relational Databases, PostgreSQL, AWS, Dynatrace

  • Documentation: Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation to aid in code understanding and future enhancements.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with team members, including architects, developers, and QA’s, to deliver high-quality software in a timely fashion. Also mentor in different areas less experienced engineers.
  • Performance Optimization: Identify and implement performance enhancements, scalability improvements, and code optimizations.
  • Technology Stack: Stay up to date with the latest Java-related technologies and frameworks to recommend and implement the best solutions.
  • Code Reviews: Collaborate with the Team Lead to drive and standarise code reviews to ensure code quality and adherence to standards.
  • Security: Implement security best practices and contribute to maintaining the security of applications.
  • Agile Development: Embrace agile development methodologies, such as Scrum or Kanban, to facilitate project delivery.



What we’re looking for:




  • Strong experience with JDBC, JDBI or ORM tools
  • Practical experience and a strong grasp of Java concurrency
  • Development of distributed systems
  • High level proficiency and skills in at least one of the following technologies: AMQP, ZeroMQ, JMS, Kafka
  • Strong experience with MVC frameworks
  • Knowledge of Spring and Spring Boot
  • Proficient in SQL
  • Understanding of principles of the Clean Architecture
  • Proficiency in backend development, including Rest API practice
  • Proficiency in principles of the Clean Architecture
  • Expert in creating automated unit and integration tests
  • Proficiency of multi-thread applications, OOP & MVC concepts and design patterns
  • Proficiency with Git or other version control systems.




Sportingtech is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and are committed to providing a work environment of mutual respect to everyone without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations and ordinances.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description:
Position Scope

The Freight Desk Manager is a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on the LATAM region . This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

  • Regional Strategy & Expansion: Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding.
  • Global Freight Desk Leadership: Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers.
  • Rate Card Governance: Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cards across a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency.
  • Strategic Sourcing: Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiatives for logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards.
  • Governance & Audit Architecture: Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments.
  • Control Tower Oversight: Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes.
  • Automation & Process Engineering: Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency.
  • Stakeholder Management: Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs.

Mandatory Requirements

  • Experience: Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments.
  • Regional Expertise: Deep knowledge of the LATAM logistics landscape , including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks.
  • Procurement Mastery: Proven track record in leading RFQs and managing complex logistics supplier onboarding processes.
  • Network Management: Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and \"Control Tower\" operational models.
  • Technical Proficiency: Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments.
  • Leadership: Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential for regional and global coordination.

Desirable Requirements

  • Advanced Education: MBA or Master’s degree.
  • Process Excellence: Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience.
  • Digital Transformation: Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools.
  • Rapid Growth Background: Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.g., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). The Recruiting Coordinator is the front-line contact for all activity related to recruiting, and will work closely with a team of recruiters, hiring managers, the business line, external vendors, and candidates. Superior interpersonal skills: The ability to establish relationships with a broad range of individuals is critical. title: Human Resources Business Partner Senior Manager (HRBP)
description:
Who we are

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and we’re on a bold mission: to revolutionize food and consumer goods delivery around the world. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.”

With innovation and technology at our core, Keeta is expanding rapidly — with over 1,000 employees worldwide — and you can be part of this global journey.


About the position

We are looking for a HRBP Manager to join our HR team in Brazil .

You will report directly to the HR Lead in Brazil and collaborate with a lean, high-impact team responsible for different business lines and strategic projects.

This is a hands-on role, ideal for someone comfortable operating in high-growth, 0→1 environments , balancing strategy, execution, and stakeholder management.

Organizational Optimization:

  • Assist business leaders in building an efficient organizational structure for Keeta, facilitating alignment of goals within the management team.
  • Regularly conduct organizational diagnostics to identify key issues and challenges, and proactively follow up on solutions.

Talent Development:

  • Utilize talent review, development, and co-creation facilitation methods to focus on the recruitment, training, development, and advancement of key talents.

Culture Implementation:

  • Drive the implementation and promotion of corporate culture and values within the department.
  • Regularly organize employee engagement and care activities to communicate company philosophy and values, strengthening team cohesion and morale.

Strategic Partnership:

  • Gain deep understanding of the business strategy of the international team.
  • Participate in the entire process from strategy formulation to execution, and develop tailored HR plans to achieve both short- and long-term business objectives.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above, with over 3 years of HR experience; experience supporting international teams is preferred.
  • Fluent in English, with strong written and verbal communication skills; able to communicate efficiently with international teams and partners.
  • Strong logical thinking and learning ability, solid HR fundamentals, self-driven, curious, and able to work under pressure.

Job Highlights:

  • Opportunity to participate in the building of an international team, broaden your horizons, and work with global talent.
  • Fast-growing business with great personal development potential; work alongside a professional and high-caliber HR team.


Nice to have

description:
Netcracker Shaping the Digital Future

As a proud subsidiary of NEC Corporation, Netcracker is a global software leader driving innovation at scale. About the role

The Finance Project Analyst will oversee financial performance for assigned projects, focusing on key metrics like budget consumption, invoicing, and cash flow. The role also involves managing vendor contracts, ensuring operational compliance, and escalating financial concerns. Additionally, the analyst will optimize processes, track project health, and assist with forecast, invoicing and payments.

Required Experience

  • 3 or more years experience working in financial analysis

  • Able to work well with others
  • Able to use discretion while dealing with confidential matters
  • Able to pay close attention to detail

  • Really good attention to detail
  • Fluent English speaker
  • Availability to work from office in hybrid mode


Education

  • BSC in Accounting/Finance, or related field

title: LÍDER DE FULFILLMENT
description:
LÍDER DE FULFILLMENT

ATENDIMENTO DE PEDIDOS E GARANTIA DE ENTREGA


Você acredita que um pedido só está \"concluído\" quando o cliente está satisfeito? Nós também, e por isso, estamos em busca de uma liderança para nossa operação de Fulfillment que seja obcecada por precisão e agilidade . Aqui, você não será apenas um acompanhante de processos; você será o protagonista que antecipa problemas, destrava gargalos logísticos e atua como a ponte estratégica entre o estoque e o Comercial, atuando como parceiro estratégico do CS.


O seu desafio: Garantir agilidade máxima no despacho e precisão absoluta no reporte. Sua missão é ser o \"GPS\" da nossa operação: saber exatamente onde cada pedido está, qual o status da transportadora e qual a real perspectiva de entrega, antes mesmo do cliente perguntar.


SUAS PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Gestão de Fluxo: Liderar o ciclo de vida do pedido, garantindo que a promessa de venda se transforme em entrega real.
  • Liderança Operacional: Líder das equipes de Faturamento e Transportes, assegurando alinhamento, fluidez e o desenvolvimento contínuo da eficiência operacional.
  • Inteligência Logística: Dominar dados de transporte, depósitos e volumes, garantindo acurácia total nas informações.
  • Parceria Estratégica com CS: Alimentar o time com perspectivas proativas para evitar surpresas negativas.
  • Comunicação com as Operações e Campo: Manter alinhamento constante com equipes internas e de campo para garantir visibilidade do status dos pedidos e rápida resolução de incidentes.
  • Foco em Resultados: Atuar com os olhos voltados para os indicadores de Lead Time (velocidade) e OTIF (entrega perfeita).


O PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS:

  • Mentalidade \"Dono do Pedido\": Alguém que não descansa enquanto houver um pedido parado ou uma informação desencontrada.
  • Visão Analítica: Capacidade de transformar o status logístico em reportes claros e estratégicos.
  • Agilidade de Execução: Resiliência e rapidez para resolver incidentes e otimizar prazos.


O objetivo final é simples: Zero surpresas negativas para o cliente e total previsibilidade para o negócio.


O QUE ESPERAMOS:

title: Supervisor(a) Manutenção Logística (Carretas)
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú


O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.


Sobre a Arauco Brasil


No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.


Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.



Desafio:


Supervisionar a manutenção das carretas florestais das empresas parceiras (Transportadoras) através de inspeções rotineiras, com visitas constantes a área de manutenção das mesmas, criando o check list padrão e gerenciando as pendencias junto ao time.



Principais Atividades:


  • Liderar e auditar o desempenho das equipes próprias na realização das atividades de inspeção dos terceiros;

title: Senior Magento Developer (Magento 2 / Performance Focus)
description:
Senior Magento Developer (Magento 2 / Performance Focus) | Remote


QAT Global, a QAT Global US-based IT consulting firm with more than 30 years in the market, is hiring a Senior Magento Developer in Brazil to join an international project supporting a US client.

This professional will work directly with client stakeholders in the US and collaborate with distributed teams across Brazil, Costa Rica, and the United States, contributing to performance improvements, technical analysis, and long-term platform stability in a complex Magento environment.


Location: 100% Remote (Brazil)

Hiring Model: CLT only

  • Analyze and improve performance across the Magento platform, identifying backend, database, and front-end bottlenecks
  • Review legacy customizations and refactor technical debt impacting platform efficiency
  • Optimize JavaScript execution and storefront rendering performance
  • Evaluate modules, extensions, and integrations according to Magento best practices
  • Support code deployment and version control using GitHub and CI/CD workflows
  • Investigate root causes of production issues and propose scalable technical solutions

  • Strong professional experience with Magento development (Magento 2 strongly preferred)

  • Proven experience troubleshooting performance issues and legacy code problems
  • Solid knowledge of JavaScript performance optimization in Magento storefronts
  • Strong experience with PHP, HTML5, CSS, and codebase improvement
  • Experience with repository management and deployment workflows using GitHub
  • Ability to work directly with technical teams and client stakeholders in English


Preferred Background:


  • Magento caching and database optimization
  • CI/CD and DevOps practices
  • Code audits and technical health assessments
  • Large-scale e-commerce environments


This role is particularly relevant for professionals who have already worked with complex Magento environments, production troubleshooting, and technical modernization of existing platforms.

title: Analista de Telecom Latam - Metodologia TEM
description:
Analista de Telecom LATAM (Remoto) - Metodologia TEM

Sobre a Mobilit

A Mobilit é uma empresa especializada na gestão e redução de despesas de telecomunicações, com atuação em todo o Brasil e América Latina. Pioneira no país na aplicação do conceito TEM (Telecom Expense Management) , seguimos um padrão global que integra tecnologia e serviços para maximizar resultados.

Nosso modelo considera todo o ciclo de vida dos recursos de telecom — desde a contratação até o pagamento — passando por gestão logística, cadastral, de uso e suporte. Essa visão integrada proporciona maior controle, inteligência e eficiência na gestão.

Com mais de 20 anos de experiência e mais de R$ 400 milhões gerenciados anualmente , somos referência no mercado.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Atuar na execução e no acompanhamento dos processos de gestão de telefonia móvel corporativa para países da América Latina, apoiando atividades de fechamento mensal, análise de inventário, gestão de linhas e equipamentos, renovações, compras, interface com operadoras e suporte às demandas das áreas internas, garantindo organização, cumprimento de prazos e qualidade das informações.

Principais atividades:

  • Acompanhar os processos de recebimento, validação e lançamento de faturas de telecom para pagamento relacionadas;
  • Apoiar na análise de desvios de gastos por países, top usuários e consolidação de informações para acompanhamento operacional;
  • Realizar a alocação (rateio) das despesas de telecom nos centros de custo, conforme critérios definidos;
  • Comunicar-se com operadoras para resolução de problemas de faturamento e negociação de prazos;
  • Manter comunicação contínua com clientes, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos de lançamento de faturas e notas fiscais;
  • Atender demandas de service desk relacionadas à telefonia móvel, incluindo:
  • Ativação, cancelamento, bloqueio e suspensão de linhas;
  • Controle de recebimento/devolução de equipamentos por país;
  • Controle de assinatura de termos;
  • Solicitação de novas linhas e/ou aparelhos;
  • Processo de MUREG (Mudança de DDD);
  • Transferência de titularidade, entre outros;
  • Realizar análises semestrais para identificação de oportunidades de otimização, como novos planos, troca de operadora, revisão de serviços e renovação de parque.
  • Apoiar o processo de compra de novos equipamentos e linhas, acompanhando solicitações e controles internos;
  • Preparar documentação necessária para operadoras e apoiar interação com áreas responsáveis por aprovações e assinaturas.
  • Apoiar processos de cotação, priorização de demandas e follow-up com fornecedores.
  • Interagir com times internos, fornecedores e operadoras para garantir andamento das demandas.
  • Sugerir melhorias de processo e apoiar iniciativas de organização da operação LATAM.


  • Auditar faturas de telecom, identificando erros de cobrança;
  • Realizar contestações e garantir o ressarcimento de valores pagos indevidamente;
  • Realizar o cadastro e a gestão detalhada do inventário de telecom (linhas móveis, fixas e circuitos de dados), garantindo a eficiência na gestão dos recursos;

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência mínima de 4 anos em telecomunicações;
  • Experiência com os sistemas Service Now, SAP, Ariba e plataformas de TEM (Telecom Expense Management).
  • Espanhol fluente;
  • Vivência com controle de demandas, acompanhamento de processos e organização de informações
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com alto volume de informações e múltiplas demandas simultâneas
  • Domínio do Pacote Office, especialmente Excel (nível intermediário a avançado);
  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Telecomunicações ou Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia, Processos Gerenciais ou áreas correlatas.


Perfil do candidato

  • Foco em atendimento ao cliente;
  • Habilidade de relacionamento com públicos internos e externos (clientes e operadoras);
  • Forte capacidade analítica e de resolução de problemas;
  • Proatividade para identificar melhorias de processos e propor soluções;
  • Flexibilidade e adaptabilidade a ambientes dinâmicos;
  • Paciência e resiliência na resolução de problemas;


Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com gestão de despesas de telecom em ambiente corporativo;
  • Vivência com grandes volumes de faturas e múltiplos centros de custo;

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
About Levity

Our client, Levity, is a no-code AI automation platform that enables companies to build and deploy AI-powered workflows without needing programming skills. Levity helps teams automate repetitive operational tasks such as processing emails, documents, images, and customer requests by training AI models on their own data. 

Founded in 2018, Levity has raised USD 12MM and is backed by top-leading investors including Balderton Capital, one of Europe’s leading venture capital firms, and Angular Ventures. 

With its HQ in Germany and Chicago, but with a global presence, its platform is designed to make AI accessible to non-technical teams by allowing them to create and deploy automation through a simple visual interface. This enables companies to streamline workflows, reduce manual work, and increase operational efficiency across functions like operations, customer support, and back-office processes. Levity has been greatly used especially by global logistics leading companies. 

In simple terms: Levity allows companies to automate complex business workflows using AI without needing engineers. 


About the role

Levity is hiring their first in‑house Lead Product Designer to own our product experience end‑to‑end and help define how design lives at Levity.


Why this role:

  • You’ll be the foundational product designer Lead at a company where design is already taken seriously.
  • You’ll work directly with the CTO, founders, solutions engineering, commercial/GTM, to shape the product, not just individual screens.
  • You’ll design at the frontier of what’s possible with AI and automation, turning complex workflows into simple, delightful experiences.


What you’ll do:

Own the product & UX:

  • Lead the end‑to‑end product design for Levity’s core product: from problem framing and flows to final UI.
  • Turn messy, real‑world automation use cases into clear, intuitive user journeys and interfaces.
  • Prototype and test with users to validate ideas quickly and iterate based on real feedback.
  • Work closely with Sebastian (CTO), engineers, GTM and solutions engineers to ensure what you design actually ships - and works.

Build systems, not one‑off:

  • Create and maintain a scalable design system (components, patterns, guidelines) that can grow with the product.
  • Ensure visual and UX consistency across product UI and other digital touchpoints (e.g. website, selected marketing surfaces).
  • Understand users deeply:
  • Run interviews, usability tests, and lightweight research with customers and internal stakeholders.
  • Distill insights into clear problems, journeys, and opportunities for the product.
  • Champion the end user in discussions with engineering, solutions, and go‑to‑market teams.

Be AI‑first in both product & process:

  • Explore and design AI‑native interaction patterns (assistants, smart defaults, conversational flows, etc.).
  • Use modern AI tools in your own workflow to ideate, prototype, and ship faster.
  • Stay on top of what’s possible with AI and bring those ideas into Levity - both in the product and in how we work.


Your Experience & Background

  • ﻿5+ years of experience in product / UX design in a fast‑moving tech company, design agency, or startup.
  • A portfolio that shows you can:
  • Own complex product areas end‑to‑end (not just isolated UI work).
  • Turn complexity into simple, elegant flows and interfaces.
  • Strong product and UX thinking :
  • You challenge requirements, clarify problems, and propose better solutions.
  • You’re comfortable making trade‑offs between scope, speed, and polish.
  • Proven experience working very closely with engineers and product / solutions teams to get things shipped.
  • Experience can be from:
  • Strong product companies or PLG SaaS,
  • Agencies or freelance practice shipping complex digital products,
  • Design‑driven startups where you were close to engineering and founders.
  • B2C or consumer products with high UX and visual quality.
  • B2B SaaS with complex workflows and demanding users, with strong user-end focus. 
  • A genuinely fast, iterative way of working : You know when 80% is enough to learn and move.
  • Real curiosity for and engagement with AI tools and new design technologies : You actively experiment with them in your work.

title: Loss Prevetion Manager
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!


ABOUT THE ROLE

Key Responsibilities

Risk Prevention & Incident Management

  • Identify and prevent risks and vulnerabilities at the earliest stage possible
  • Intervene in ongoing incidents to minimize impact and exposure
  • Lead thorough investigations of security-related incidents to identify root causes and prevent recurrence

Risk Assessment & Strategy

  • Evaluate threats, assess risks, and develop effective risk management strategies
  • Implement risk-based, balanced, and cost-effective security measures aligned with industry best practices

Security Operations & Compliance

  • Ensure consistent application of security and loss prevention standards across all operations
  • Maintain high levels of compliance with internal policies and external regulations
  • Oversee security practices across operations, infrastructure, administration, and support functions

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build trusted partnerships with internal and external stakeholders
  • Support and advise business units to enable safe and successful execution of operations and initiatives

Culture & Continuous Improvement

  • Promote security awareness and drive continuous improvement initiatives
  • Engage leadership and associates in strengthening security culture
  • Ensure a safe and secure working environment for all employees


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree (or higher) in Security Management, Risk Management, Business Administration , or a related field (preferred)
  • Significant experience in loss prevention and security operations , ideally in a management role
  • Experience within distribution or logistics environments is highly desirable
  • Proven track record in developing, implementing, and managing loss prevention programs
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to gather and interpret data from multiple sources
  • Ability to assess situations holistically, considering all relevant facts and perspectives


CAREERS AT SHEIN


We Commit to Inclusion

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.


We Empower Talents with Diverse Careers

At SHEIN, we empower talent to excel with regular opportunities to elevate their career in their respective fields. As a dynamic business, we support internal mobility, diverse career pathways and recognition of success and contribution in a variety of meaningful ways.


We Engage with Global Cultures

SHEIN has over 20 offices worldwide , providing talent with many opportunities to collaborate with colleagues around the world. Perspective sharing and leveraging cultural differences, is one of our core strenghts as we work on many exciting projects and draw insights from industry-leading experience.

title: Talent Acquisition Analyst (Temporary contract)
description:

We believe in technology that connects talented people who embrace diversity to create and share paths we don't even know about (yet!). We work to generate value not only for our users but, above all, for the communities we serve and for society as a whole, making every day better for everyone with mobility and delivery services (99) or digital payments (99Pay).

To make life easier for millions of people every day, since 2018, we have been part of DiDi DiDi Global Inc., the world’s leading mobility technology platform. We are pioneers in creating innovative solutions that start in Brazil and scale up to make a positive impact in more than 12 countries where DiDi operates. This innovation encompasses sustainability, safety, artificial intelligence, financial markets, and much more.

Whether building projects from scratch or improving our solutions, we enjoy challenges that give us butterflies, which is why we work at a fast pace with respect, collaboration, and good humor. Along this journey, we also draw strength from diverse experiences and opinions to grow together, fail quickly, learn, and adjust the course to create solutions that deliver even better results.

We drive new growth opportunities for our teams by running talent programs, where our employees can expand their horizons globally.


In this role you will be...

  • Responsible to manage the full end-to-end hiring cycle for roles across multiple teams in the organization.
  • Acting as a strategic partner to business leaders; providing world-class market information, talent intelligence and key practices.
  • Owning the overall candidate experience through the hiring process until onboarding.
  • Using data to make decisions that facilitate hiring and allows the organization to make the best hiring decision.
  • Working with other HR teams to drive efficiencies and process improvements.
  • Working in projects that impact how we shape a culture of recruiting.


We are eager to be in touch with you because you have...

  • Strong verbal and written communication in English and spanish.
  • Excited about driving change and helping the organization evolve.
  • Knowledgeable about talent acquisition techniques (offer negotiation, sourcing, etc).


You‘ll love working at DiDi because:

  • We create customer value – We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant, and efficient.
  • We are data-driven – We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.
  • We believe in Win-win Collaboration – Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.
  • We believe in integrity – Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.
  • We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.
  • We believe in Diversity and Inclusion – Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what makes us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.


Diversity & Inclusion


Diversity is not a future vision or a wish for something we want someday; it is a non-negotiable value of who we are today.

We embrace inclusion, plurality, and respect, and to achieve this, we rely on the governance of the Diversity Committee, which works alongside HR, our leadership, and identity groups—99Adapta, 99Afro, 99Colors, 99Womem, and 99Familys.

This is our ongoing journey, with much more still to come.

We reinforce that this position is open to everyone, including pregnant people and people with disabilities (PwD).

• Experiência com funding, gestão de liquidez e análise de estrutura de balanço.

title: [Tech] Especialista em Engenharia de Dados (REMOTO)
description:
A missão do Especialista em Engenharia de Dados será atuar na arquitetura, construção e evolução do Data Lake e dos produtos de dados desenvolvidos pelo time, incluindo soluções de Analytics, agentes e modelos de machine learning.


Trabalhará em conjunto com outro especialista de engenharia de dados na definição e implementação de arquiteturas, modelagem e disponibilização de dados em ambientes distribuídos, utilizando tecnologias como AWS, Spark, Trino e Athena, além de viabilizar o consumo eficiente dessas informações por ferramentas como o Metabase.


Será responsável por desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados, garantindo performance, escalabilidade, qualidade e governança das informações. Espera-se que o profissional atue com alta autonomia técnica, contribuindo para decisões de arquitetura e para a evolução contínua do ecossistema de dados, assegurando que as soluções atendam às necessidades analíticas e de inteligência dos produtos com robustez e confiabilidade.


O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Atuar na construção e evolução da arquitetura do Data Lake e dos produtos de dados do time (Analytics, agentes e modelos);
  • Desenvolver, otimizar e manter pipelines de dados escaláveis e confiáveis em ambiente AWS;
  • Modelar e estruturar dados para consumo analítico e operacional, garantindo qualidade, performance e governança;
  • Definir padrões, arquiteturas e boas práticas de dados;
  • Implementar e otimizar consultas e camadas de acesso a dados utilizando Athena e Trino;
  • Processar e transformar grandes volumes de dados utilizando Spark;
  • Garantir a disponibilização eficiente de datasets para consumo em ferramentas analíticas como Metabase;
  • Monitorar, diagnosticar e otimizar o desempenho de pipelines, queries e tabelas no Data Lake;
  • Assegurar qualidade, integridade e rastreabilidade dos dados ao longo de todo o pipeline;
  • Apoiar a definição de estratégias de particionamento, versionamento e organização de dados;
  • Contribuir com a documentação técnica e evolução das boas práticas de engenharia de dados;
  • Acompanhar tendências e propor melhorias contínuas no ecossistema de dados e nas tecnologias


O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Graduação completa em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência sólida em engenharia de dados, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados em larga escala;
  • Domínio de SQL avançado para manipulação e otimização de grandes volumes de dados;
  • Experiência prática com processamento distribuído utilizando Spark;
  • Experiência com serviços de dados na AWS (ex: S3, Glue, Athena, IAM, entre outros);
  • Experiência com engines de consulta distribuída, como Athena e/ou Trino;
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como Código (Terraform)
  • Experiência em streaming de dados em tempo real (Apache Kafka)
  • Conhecimento em bancos relacionais (PostgreSQL), não relacionais (MongoDB) e vetoriais (Milvus, Pinecone, S3 Vector)
  • Experiência em governança de dados (Apache Ranger)
  • Conhecimento em Data lake/lakehouse moderno (Iceberg, PyIceberg)
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de qualidade, governança e organização de dados;
  • Experiência trabalhando em conjunto com times multidisciplinares (dados, produto e engenharia);
  • Capacidade de estruturar soluções de dados escaláveis e de alta performance.


SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE:

  • Experiência com disponibilização de dados para ferramentas de BI, como Metabase, Power BI ou Tableau;
  • Vivência com otimização de queries e particionamento de tabelas em Data Lake;
  • Experiência com orquestração de pipelines (ex: Airflow ou similares);
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura de Data Lake;
  • Experiência prévia suportando times de Ciência de Dados e Machine Learning;
  • Conhecimento em práticas de DataOps e observabilidade de pipelines;
  • Pós-graduação ou cursos especializados em Engenharia de Dados, Big Data ou Arquitetura de Dados.

title: Coordenador(a) Manutenção Logística - Execução
description:
Sobre o Projeto Sucuriú


O Projeto Sucuriú marca a entrada da divisão de celulose da Arauco no Brasil. O investimento de US$4.6 bilhões inclui a construção de uma planta com capacidade de produção de 3,5 milhões de toneladas de fibra curta de celulose/ano. Está localizado em uma área de 3.500 hectares, a 50 quilômetros do centro da cidade de Inocência (MS) e ao lado do Rio Sucuriú. A etapa de terraplanagem começou em 2024 e a previsão de entrada em operação é no final de 2027. Em todas as fases desenvolvimento do Projeto, e de maneira contínua, monitora e respeita a biodiversidade local, identificando espécies de flora e fauna nativas da região, além de fazer o mapeamento das áreas prioritárias para conservação. Durante as obras, a Arauco vai oferecer capacitação e gerar mais de 14 mil oportunidades de trabalho. Depois do start up, o Projeto Sucuriú empregará cerca de 6 mil pessoas nas unidades Industrial, Florestal e operações de Logística. O propósito é impulsionar o desenvolvimento social e econômico para toda região, fomentando um aumento na geração de renda e na arrecadação de impostos, além de contribuir para atrair investimentos.


Sobre a Arauco Brasil


No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras. As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose brasileira em Inocência (MS). Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.


Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.



Desafio:


Coordenar as operações de manutenção automotiva logística, desde equipamentos de estradas, carregamento, transporte e pátio de madeira garantindo o cumprimento das metas operacionais, praticando segurança em todos os níveis de operação, garantindo a conformidade legal e a excelência no atendimento ao cliente interno, assegurando previsibilidade no estoque de produtos, organização e padrão de qualidade.

title: Live Streaming Internship
description:
Location : Remote

Type : Academy Internship Programme

Duration : 3 to 6 months


City Explorer is a media and technology organisation focused on real time video content and digital engagement.


City Explorer Academy provides structured training in livestreaming, video production, content creation, and digital marketing. This internship is designed for individuals who are interested in developing skills in live video broadcasting and content development.


Programme Fee

Participation in the City Explorer Academy involves a one-time programme fee that supports the training, mentorship, equipment, sponsored travel in the second phase of the programme, and access to the livestreaming platform throughout the internship.


Internship Duration Options

• 3-month internship: Includes the full 3-month Academy training period.

• 4 to 6-month internship: Includes the 3-month Academy training period followed by international livestream assignments for selected participants.


Training Structure during the First 3 Months

• Unit 1: Live Streaming and Video Content

• Unit 2: Creative Content Creation

• Unit 3: Social Media and Marketing


During the training period, interns will attend online sessions, complete assessments, livestream a minimum of 5 hours per week, follow City Explorer guidelines, and participate in content planning activities.


International Assignments

Interns who join the 4 to 6-month route and successfully complete the initial 3 months may be selected for international livestream assignments. City Explorer will cover travel, accommodation, and meals during these assignments. Additional coaching will be provided to help interns apply their training in real world environments.


Progression

High performing interns may be considered for future opportunities within the organisation.


How to Apply

Click the Apply Now button and complete the application process through this platform.

City Explorer is committed to providing equal opportunities and supports a diverse and inclusive working environment.

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

title: Gerente de P&D e Inovação
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Responsável por identificar, avaliar, desenvolver e implementar tecnologias e soluções inovadoras com foco na melhoria da eficiência operacional, aumento de performance, redução de custos e ganho de produtividade nos sistemas de abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário, bem como em obras lineares e processos construtivos associados.

  • Atuar como elo entre áreas corporativas, unidades operacionais e fornecedores, promovendo interação técnica e influência na adoção de soluções.
  • Liderar testes-piloto, provas de conceito e projetos de escalabilidade tecnológica.

Gerenciar processos de negociação técnica e comercial com fornecedores e parceiros tecnológicos.

  • Apoiar e supervisionar operações e manutenção em:

Obras lineares;

Escavação, compactação, recomposição de pavimento;

Tampas de bueiro, ligações de água e esgoto.


  • Gerenciar equipes operacionais e de manutenção em sistemas de abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário.

description:

This individual will support inbound sales processes by providing with proposals to global sellers, while also upselling and cross selling to an existing client portfolio. Will be responsible of non-complex renewal processes.

  • Build an Expiring Contract map by country and for non-complex local renewal, develop a T-12 activity plan for each contract expiration to ensure renewal on time.

  • Support inbound sales processes by providing with proposals to global senior sellers.
  • Support local office with administrative tasks (update CRM, follow up on KYC process).
  • Work as part of a deal team to ensure the best customer experience and response.
  • Meet monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.



Key Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in business, sales, marketing, or a related field
  • Relevant working experience in a commercial environment, or in consulting, accounting, or law firms.
  • Very good English written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to build strong relationships with clients at all levels.
  • Able to “solution sell” where the ability to listen to the clients and understand what they. really need is more important than a hard sell.
  • Self-motivated and able to work both independently and as part of a team.
  • Strong communication, good negotiation skills.
  • Results-oriented, and able to manage their priorities/workload.
  • Experience working in or with direct sales, pre-sales and/or enablement in an enterprise software and/or SaaS environment.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office.

description:
Cross Border Specialist


We are looking for a Cross Border Specialist to manage and optimize the performance of Third-Party Logistics (3PL) providers across South America . This role plays a key part in ensuring efficient cross-border operations, seamless customs clearance, strong last-mile performance, and effective reverse logistics.


If you enjoy working with data, solving operational challenges, and collaborating with international partners in a fast-paced environment, this opportunity is for you!



What you’ll do:

  • Monitor and manage 3PL performance, ensuring compliance with SLAs
  • Track customs clearance deadlines and identify operational bottlenecks
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective action plans
  • Manage order delays, system failures, and tracking rule accuracy
  • Support last-mile operations and improve delivery performance
  • Analyze KPIs such as failure rates, delivery performance, and customer feedback
  • Collaborate with logistics partners to reduce return cycle times
  • Ensure proper closure of uncompleted shipments and claim settlements



What we’re looking for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Business Administration, or related fields
  • At least 2 years of experience in 3PL management or supply chain operations
  • Experience with cross-border logistics is a strong plus
  • Solid understanding of customs clearance, last-mile delivery, and reverse logistics
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven mindset
  • Proficiency in Excel ; SQL and logistics systems are a plus
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese
  • Spanish and Mandarin are a plus
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic, international environment



Why join us?

  • Exposure to cross-border and international logistics operations
  • High-impact role with visibility across South America
  • Opportunity to work with multiple logistics partners and stakeholders
  • Fast-paced environment with room for growth and learning



Interested? Apply now or share with someone who might be a great fit!

description:

HCLTech is a global technology company, spread across 60 countries, delivering industry-leading capabilities centered around digital, engineering, cloud and AI, powered by a broad portfolio of technology services and products. Overall Responsibilities: The Transportation Specialist will be responsible for supporting our e-Commerce Transportation Operation for North America. The specialist will work with carriers, customers and internal stakeholders to execute daily transportation management functions following documented SOPs and providing status updates to the hiring manager.


Core Responsibilities


1. Data Analysis & Shipment Integrity (Primary Focus)

• Proactive Monitoring: Query large datasets to identify lagging or \"at-risk\" shipments across sales, returns, and trade-in flows.

• Performance Reporting: Maintain and update centralized KPI boards and dashboards to ensure real-time visibility for internal stakeholders.

• SQL Management: Execute minor SQL queries to extract, filter, and audit transportation data from internal databases.

• Root Cause Analysis: Perform deep-dive investigations into weekly and monthly On-Time Delivery (OTD) fluctuations to identify systemic carrier or lane issues.


2. Transportation Operations Support (Secondary Focus)

• Escalation Management: Resolve complex shipment status inquiries by collaborating with carriers (UPS, FedEx, DHL), 3PL partners, and Fulfillment teams.

• Master Data Maintenance: Support the Transportation Operations Manager in configuring and troubleshooting master data within the Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Act as the data subject matter expert (SME) for ongoing logistics projects and process improvement initiatives.


Technical Requirements

• Data Handling: 1–3 years of professional experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a data-intensive operations role.

• SQL Proficiency: Ability to write and execute basic SQL queries for data extraction and manipulation.

• Advanced Tooling: Expert-level proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel (Pivot Tables, complex formulas, data cleaning).

• Visualization: Experience maintaining or updating dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Looker, or Data Studio).


Operational Requirements

• Industry Knowledge: Foundational understanding of parcel transportation or warehouse operations.

• Analytical Thinking: Proven ability to navigate ambiguity, identify trends in \"noisy\" data, and propose actionable solutions.

• Communication: Strong ability to present data findings in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.

• Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.


Preferred Skills/Qualifications:

• Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).

• Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.

• Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.

• Prior Forecasting experience


Location: LATAM (Must align with US PST Time Zone)


Language Requirement:

Advanced English

Role Overview

We are seeking a Media Tech Support professional to support file-based media workflows in a dynamic and global environment.

This role is responsible for handling support requests, collaborating with engineering teams to resolve issues, validating solutions, and maintaining accurate technical documentation.

The ideal candidate is highly self-sufficient, capable of working independently, and committed to delivering high-quality support and excellent customer experience. Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly explain complex technical concepts are essential.

Systems & Tools

  • Familiarity with Jira and Slack
  • Experience working in customer support or service-oriented environments

Automation & Integration

  • Understanding of API protocols

Cloud

  • Experience working with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
  • Ability to operate and test systems in cloud-based environments (Linux/Windows instances)

Soft Skills

title: Analista Ambiental | Socioambiental

Sobre a VSZ


A Ventos de São Zacarias é uma empresa de geração de energia renovável no Nordeste do Brasil, comprometido com as melhores práticas ambientais, sociais e de governança (ESG), alinhado a referenciais internacionais como Padrões de Desempenho do IFC e Princípios do Equador.

Nosso compromisso é gerar energia limpa promovendo desenvolvimento sustentável e relações transparentes e duradouras com as comunidades locais.


Propósito da Posição


O(a) Analista Ambiental terá papel fundamental na gestão técnica e implementação do Plano de Gestão Ambiental e Social (PBA) na fase de operação do Complexo Eólico, assegurando a governança do atendimento às condicionantes ambientais, a conformidade regulatória e o monitoramento sistemático do desempenho ambiental.

Atuará como interface técnica junto a órgãos ambientais, comunidades locais, proprietários de terra e demais partes interessadas, contribuindo para a mitigação de riscos socioambientais e para a consolidação da estratégia da empresa.


Principais Responsabilidades


1️⃣ Implementação de Programas Socioambientais

  • Atuar na gestão técnica e estratégica dos processos de licenciamento ambiental (LP, LI, LO e renovações), incluindo interface com órgãos ambientais, análise de riscos e definição de estratégias regulatórias, tanto para o Complexo Eólico em operação quanto para novos desenvolvimentos.
  • Planejar, estruturar e monitorar o atendimento às condicionantes ambientais, propondo soluções viáveis e ambientalmente eficazes e assegurando rastreabilidade e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Executar, supervisionar e orientar os Planos e Programas previstos no PBA, garantindo conformidade legal e regulatória.
  • Prestar suporte técnico em temas ambientais do Complexo Eólico, incluindo monitoramento de efluentes, potabilidade, gestão de resíduos, controle de emissões atmosféricas, controle de processos erosivos, acompanhamento do PRAD, reposição florestal e compromissos associados a plano de manejo de RPPN.
  • Realizar inspeções ambientais preventivas com foco na identificação de aspectos e impactos, mitigação de riscos e prevenção de passivos ambientais.
  • Acompanhar tecnicamente atividades e intervenções em campo no âmbito do Complexo Eólico.
  • Conduzir a análise crítica de estudos ambientais e projetos executivos, e gerenciar e apoiar consultorias e contratadas terceiras, assegurando conformidade regulatória, qualidade técnica, controle de escopo e entregáveis, e custo-efetividade.
  • Elaborar, revisar e consolidar relatórios técnicos e documentos requeridos para manutenção das licenças e atendimento às condicionantes.
  • Apoiar auditorias e processos de certificação internos e externos, bem como executar plano de ação de atendimento às oportunidades de melhorias identificados nestas.
  • Atuar e apoiar na governança de auditorias e certificações internas e externas, assegurando gestão estruturada de não conformidades e implementação de planos de ação de atendimento às oportunidades de melhorias identificas.
  • Monitorar e apoiar a gestão do Sistema de Gestão Ambiental (SGA), incluindo revisão e aprimoramento de procedimentos internos.
  • Acompanhar indicadores ambientais e desempenho dos programas de forma crítica, propondo ajustes e iniciativas de melhoria contínua.
  • Prestar suporte técnico às lideranças diretas e indiretas.


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Ambiental, Engenharia Agronômica, Engenharia Florestal, Biologia, ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em:
  • Gestão de Planos e Programas Ambientais e atendimento a condicionantes ambientais;
  • Processos de licenciamento ambiental e interface com órgãos reguladores;
  • Atuação em projetos de infraestrutura ou energia renovável
  • CNH válida e disponibilidade para atuação em campo.
  • Pacote Office (Excel intermediário/avançado).


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com Padrões de Desempenho do IFC e Princípios do Equador.
  • Vivência em projetos no Nordeste.
  • Inglês intermediário.
  • Experiência com SAP ou CRM.

  • Organização, disciplina operacional e elevado nível de atenção a detalhes e prazos.

  • Pensamento crítico e capacidade de propor soluções técnicas viáveis, com foco na mitigação de riscos e na eficiência técnico-operacional.


O que oferecemos

  • Plano de desenvolvimento profissional.

  • Ambiente dinâmico e orientado a impacto positivo.

title: Coordenador(a) de Desenvolvimento Imobiliário

  • Acompanhar, conduzir e destravar processos de licenciamento urbanístico e ambiental, atuando na resolução de exigências técnicas junto aos órgãos competentes;
  • Garantir a tramitação eficiente dos processos junto aos órgãos públicos e entidades reguladoras;
  • Coordenar uma equipe, conduzindo práticas de gestão de pessoas (feedbacks, avaliação de desempenho, construção de metas), manter a equipe engajada.


O que esperamos de você?


  • Formação superior em Arquitetura e Urbanismo ou Engenharia Civil;

  • Proatividade e capacidade de resolução de problemas;

Outras informações:


  • Remuneração compatível com o mercado.
